description.subtitle: Portugal National Team Puma Training Water Bottle 750ml - Black
description.intro: The 750 ml Puma Portugal bottle combines functionality and official design of the team. A practical and resistant piece to accompany you in every workout and show your support at all times.
key_benefits: Practical capacity: 750 ml that ensures sufficient hydration during activity.
Team identity: design with the official image of the Portugal National Team.
Material resistente: pensado para el uso deportivo y cotidiano.
Portable Design: Convenient size to carry in backpacks or sports bags.
